note: PEARL-CONTRACT v1.0 rev 3 test vectors. machine: the traveller state machine (every codebase runs these cases step by step; an event gives the expected step, state, whispers, away flag, watch flag and actions; tries/code/warning where given). reports: what the server derives (chamber state, arrival agreement with clock skew, pearl counts, report bodies, identity). Times are milliseconds; skew = receivedAt - at, normalised = time + skew.

events.offer: the heartbeat reply carries a trip for this bot: {action}
events.precheck: the local precheck result: {ok} or {ok:false, code}; codes busy_order, busy_repair and sorter_busy don't use up tries
events.retryTick: 30 s passed while paused (a counted pause is retried at most 3 times)
events.reply: a later heartbeat reply: any of {go, armHome, retry, rearm, hold, cancel, state, code, pearlId, loader, pullDeadlineAt, stillHere}
events.teleport: T saw a teleport: {jump} (>= 8 blocks in a tick) or {dimChange} (any dimension change)
events.pullDeadline: the pull deadline passed: {stillHere} (T is at the position and dimension where it whispered; default true)
events.watchEnd: five minutes passed after a failure
events.pickupDone: the dropped pearl was picked up, or 5 s passed
events.disconnect: T lost its connection (nothing can happen)
events.reconnect: T is back: {teleported} (its journal saw a teleport)

cases.name: go, the whole way (pickup before the re-arm)
back clears the away guard when it ends
a counted pause is retried three times, then waits for the owner
busy_order waits without using up tries
a server pause through the reply, then it goes
the home chamber is armed first when the server asks
one retry whisper, never a third
the server extends the pull deadline once the loader is loading
no pull by the deadline and T is still where it whispered: pull_timeout, guard off, watch on
a late pull while watching becomes unexpected_location with hold
the watch ends after five minutes
at the deadline T is no longer where it whispered: the pull already happened
loader_no_answer from the server: guard off, watch on, no report needed
a short rubber-band is not an arrival
a change to the wrong dimension is reported and the server holds
cancel works before the whisper
a cancel after the whisper is ignored
T disconnects after the whisper and resumes from its journal: the teleport was seen
T disconnects after the whisper and resumes: nothing yet, keep waiting
the server restarted past load_sent and T never left: same as pull_timeout (guard off, watch on)
the server restarted past load_sent and T is no longer there: it stays away
a failed re-arm still completes the trip with a warning

chamberState.note: state = broken if broken; unknown if the report is older than 60000 ms; owner_offline if the presence is empty and the owner's game is not 'in'; else the presence.

arrival.note: confirmed when pearlGoneAt and requesterNearAt are both set, and after normalising (time + skew of the sender) both are >= loadSentAt and within 10000 ms of teleportAt, and teleportAt is no later than the pull deadline: max(loadSentAt + 150000, loadingAt + 150000) with loadingAt (L's load.at when it reported loading) normalised too.

cases.name: plain agreement
10 s apart is still agreement
10.001 s apart is not
the pearl was never seen gone
T was never seen near the chamber
everything before the whisper does not count
pearlGoneAt earlier than loadSentAt does not confirm
requesterNearAt earlier than loadSentAt does not confirm
the last second of the 150 s window
one millisecond after it
T's clock is 30 s ahead (skew -30000): normalised, it agrees
the same times with no skew correction would not
L's clock is 30 s behind (skew +30000): normalised, it agrees
L reports loading 60 s after the whisper: the deadline moves to loading + 150 s, a teleport at +190 s is confirmed
the same teleport without a loading report is past the 150 s deadline
one millisecond past the extended deadline
the loading time is on L's clock (30 s behind)

pearlCount.note: exp = before - (armedHome ? 1 : 0) + (dropAfterLoad ? 1 : 0) - 1; the trip completes with the warning pearl_count unless after is exp, or exp - 1 when dropAfterLoad is true.

bodies.note: loader report bodies: ok = accepted (200), else 400.

an owner nobody resolved
a load in progress
an aborted load
a failed reopen (addon loader)
a finished load with the arrival times
temporaryMode on is accepted (the station is flagged)
an unknown presence word

identity.note: a report's player must equal the station loader's player and the transport's player (case-insensitive): else 409. No matching station: accepted, allow is empty.

cases.name: the plugin loader: body, station and hello agree
case does not matter
the transport player is someone else
the body names a different player than the station's loader
a player that is no station's loader is accepted with an empty allow list
